results.why: The claim states that every hydration cycle lands a commit on the branch child Applications deploy from and that each such commit is seen as a source change restarting the RollingSync wave, so rollouts only finish if hydration is quiet.

The claim asserts the roadmap's commitment that ordered/automated child deletion will not be implemented and teardown stays manual, against the PRD adding deletionOrder to the strategy, which is the planted contradiction.

The claim states Reverse depends on rollingSync.steps remaining a strictly sequential list while the parallel-steps proposal evaluates several match-sets concurrently within a step, removing exactly that property.
The claim states the Stable promotion freezes the steps shape under the backward-compatibility bar and thereby forecloses the parallel-steps proposal's in-place restructuring of that same field.

The claim states the CommitManifests proto2 required fields can never be loosened and that the rollback flow, as the second caller, would have to supply dry-commit-only fields that do not describe what it pushes.
